import numpy as np
def equation(t, P, params):
    p = params
    s = np.sqrt(t); u = np.sqrt(P)
    return (p[0] + p[1]*P + p[2]*P**2 + p[3]*s + p[4]*t + p[5]*P*t
            + p[6]*P*s + p[7]*u*t + p[8]*u*s + p[9]*P**2*t)
